trailhead.label: Vahrn village car park (Dorfparkplatz), the official start

waypoints.label: Drinking fountain at the Kneipp park

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
Short stretch on the village road (40 km/h, pavement on one side).
Road crossings in the village, including the Schalderer Straße hairpin with no pavement.
Tarmac lanes that get hot in summer (about 30% of the loop).
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
